item.title: Philosophy – Delor
item.description:
This blog deals with philosophy, with a focus on ethics, critical rationalism, and metaethics.

At its center are book reviews, critiques of ethical schools, the is-ought problem, and a prescriptive evolutionary ethics based on critical rationalism.

Many texts are critical, some are satirical, and all are meant seriously.
